subject: İngilizce Dersi
title: Unit 6: Fun with Science
description: Giving and responding to simple instructions: Plant it. Water it. Cut the paper. Don’t cut it now! Fold it. Mix black and white, and you get gray. | Making simple inquiries: What is “science” in Turkish? What is “cover”? What is in the cup? | Talking about locations: Where is the brush? —It’s in front of the bottle. —Behind the box. —Near that glass.

outcomes.title: Students will be able to understand and follow simple instructions
Students will be able to recognize phrases/descriptions about locations
Students will be able to give short and basic instructions
Students will be able to talk about locations of objects
Students will be able to ask and answer simple clarification questions
